question_text: योगसूत्र में ‘प्रच्छर्दनविधारणाभ्यां वा प्राणस्य’ चित्त-प्रसादन का कौन-सा उपाय है?
detailed_explanation:
**Answer: (2) द्वितीय.**

The means of making the mind serene run from YS 1.33 to 1.39. The first is the four bhāvanās (1.33); the **second** is expelling and retaining the breath (*pracchardana-vidhāraṇābhyāṃ vā prāṇasya*, 1.34); then sense-object awareness (1.35), the luminous state (1.36), a mind free of passion (1.37), dream and sleep knowledge (1.38) and any chosen object (1.39).
